title: OFF SHFT Logo Beanie
descriptionHtml:
The O in OFF is a clock. The hands say 5:00.

Quitting time. The rest of the day is your time.

Toque weather. For cold mornings on the water and the walk back to the truck.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Cuff: the OFF SHFT logo, embroidered, about 63 mm (2.5 in) wide
  • Styles: Cuffed or Ribbed
  • Cuffed: 100% acrylic knit, 12 in (30 cm) long. Hand wash
  • Ribbed: ribbed knit, with a turned-up cuff
  • One size
seoDescription: The O in OFF is a clock set to 5:00. Quitting time. The OFF SHFT logo, embroidered on a beanie made to order. Toque weather.

styleNotes.Cuffed: Cuffed knit beanie in 100% acrylic, 12 in (30 cm) long. One size. Hand wash.
styleNotes.Ribbed: Ribbed knit beanie with a turned-up cuff. One size.

toConfirm: Check the Ribbed style (RIO) in Printful with Embroidery selected: cuff spot, one size, care and price (US$16.75 in a March copy of Printful's data). It's C$39.99 because C$34.99 wouldn't clear the C$10 floor.
The Ribbed style's fabric is left out (a copy of Printful's data says half recycled polyester, half acrylic). Add it only if Printful's page says so.

The logo's clock-hand tips (0.58–0.59 mm) and its 1.0 mm gap between the ring and the hands are under Printful's 1.27 mm minimum, and the Ribbed style's rib can blur fine lines. Get a sew-out on both styles before selling. Samples cost money, so it's your call.
Check the cuff template on each style's File guidelines tab (5 x 1.75 in expected).

Size & fit (text and meta description), the FAQ and, if live, the product page's Size & fit row say hats adjust at the back or have a head-size range. Beanies don't adjust, and Printful gives no head size. Fix those before these go live; the 'Fit questions?' link stays off until then.

title: OFF SHFT Logo Quarter-Zip
descriptionHtml:
The O in OFF is a clock. The hands say 5:00.

Quitting time. The rest of the day is your time.

For an early round and the couch after.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Left chest: the OFF SHFT logo, embroidered, about 63 mm (2.5 in) wide
  • Unisex fleece, with a stand collar, rib cuffs and waistband
  • Fit: relaxed

Which size? See Size & fit.
seoDescription: The O in OFF is a clock set to 5:00. Quitting time. The OFF SHFT logo, embroidered on a quarter-zip made to order. For the course, then the couch.

styleNotes.Fleece: Unisex fleece quarter-zip with a stand collar, rib cuffs and waistband, and a relaxed fit.

toConfirm: Product type Quarter-Zip is new: add it to the Lounge and Everything rules (check the live rules first). If the Lounge text still says 'Oversized hoodies, crewnecks and sweats', change it when these join (they're relaxed fit, not oversized).

Only the Fleece (M2475) is listed for now. Once Printful's editor shows left-chest embroidery on the Mock Neck (LS14014; Printful's name says 'Premium', which the template rules out) and its price with it, add it at C$79.99: style note 'Unisex fleece quarter-zip with a mock neck and a relaxed fit.', and the two lines under the chest line become 'Styles: Mock Neck or Fleece', 'Both styles: unisex fleece, relaxed fit' and 'Fleece: stand collar, rib cuffs and waistband'.
Fabric is left out because the blend changes by colour (65% cotton, 35% polyester; Carbon Grey 55/45). Add it once colours are picked, and check the collar, cuff and fit lines on Printful's page.
Check the size picker: S to 3XL is from copies of Printful's catalogue, and the sweatpants and jacket turned out S to 2XL there. Size & fit needs a quarter-zip chart before these go live.

The logo's clock-hand tips (0.58–0.59 mm) and its 1.0 mm gap between the ring and the hands are under Printful's 1.27 mm minimum. Get a sew-out on each style before selling. Samples cost money, so it's your call.

title: Punched Out. Golf Shirt
descriptionHtml:
Punched out.

Shift's over. Tee's up.

For nine holes after work, or eighteen on your day off.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Styles: Cotton Pique, Classic or Performance
  • Left chest: PUNCHED OUT., embroidered on two lines, about 64 mm (2.5 in) wide
  • Left sleeve: the clock, embroidered, about 25 mm (1 in) tall
  • Cotton Pique: 6.2 oz/yd² (210 g/m²). Ribbed collar, three buttons, side slits
  • Classic: 65% polyester, 35% cotton pique. Flat knit collar, side vents. Men's cut, relaxed fit that runs large
  • Performance: 100% recycled polyester, 4.3 oz/yd² (146 g/m²). Relaxed fit. Right sleeve: the shirt maker's own logo

Which size? See Size & fit.
seoTitle: Punched Out. Embroidered Golf Shirt | OFF SHFT
seoDescription: Shift's over. Tee's up. Punched Out., embroidered on a golf shirt made to order. For nine holes after work, or eighteen on your day off.

styleNotes.Cotton Pique: Cotton pique polo, 6.2 oz/yd² (210 g/m²), with a ribbed collar, three-button placket and side slits.
styleNotes.Classic: Men's polo in 65% polyester, 35% cotton pique, with a flat knit collar and side vents, in a relaxed fit that runs large.
styleNotes.Performance: Polo in 100% recycled polyester, 4.3 oz/yd² (146 g/m²), in a relaxed fit, with the shirt maker's own logo on the right sleeve.

toConfirm: Before it sells, open the US record for POWER PUNCHOUT (Reg. 5079893) first: it covers caps, hats, hooded sweatshirts, polo shirts and T-shirts. The PUNCHED OUT check so far is search results only (designs/09-punched-out/trademark-search.md).
Product type Polo is new: add it to the Everything rule (check the live rules first).
No golf tag (Punched Out. isn't about golf). If you add one, change any 'Hats…' or 'Golf Hats' in the Golf collection's copy.

To put the clock on the Cotton Pique's back, check in Printful (Canada, then US) that Large back embroidery is offered, how near the collar the clock can sit (aim: its centre 45 mm below the neck seam) and what it adds (US$2.95 assumed). If so, the sleeve line becomes 'The clock, embroidered, about 25 mm (1 in) tall: upper back on the Cotton Pique, left sleeve on the Classic and Performance'.
Never 'near the neck': no source shows a Printful polo with an embroidery spot just below the collar.
The Cotton Pique may be made only in Latvia (longer shipping, maybe duties): check its Availability tab first. If so, the research's stand-in is the Gildan 64800 cotton polo, clock on the sleeve.

The Performance (A430) costs about twice the others. At C$89.99 a 3XL that ships free makes C$11.63, just over the C$10 floor; if Printful makes it in Ontario while the store isn't GST/HST-registered, an Ontario order makes C$2.52 to C$8.94, under it. Keep it, sell it S to 2XL only, register for GST/HST, or drop it.

The clock's hand tips (about 0.71–0.73 mm) and its 1.2 mm gap between the ring and the hands are under Printful's 1.27 mm minimum, and a Printful review says the Performance's thin fabric 'does not get embroidered well'. Get a sew-out of both marks on each style before selling. Samples cost money, so it's your call.

In Printful with Embroidery selected, check each style's price, sizes, left sleeve spot (the Performance's rests on one search read) and fabric and build lines (from copies and search reads), and the Performance's photos for the maker's logo on the right sleeve. If you pick Grey Melange for the Cotton Pique, add its blend (85% cotton, 15% viscose).
Size & fit says sizes are unisex and has no polo charts, but the Classic (K500) is a men's cut. Add a chart for each style before this goes live.
